summary_en: Final dividend raised to ¥54/share from ¥48/share (¥6 increase). Cumulative FY3/27 dividend ¥54/share (prev. forecast ¥48/share). Progressive policy targets ¥40/share minimum or 50% payout ratio (higher of the two). Prior-year (FY3/26) final dividend ¥40/share.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision to Second Quarter (Interim) and Full-Year Earnings Forecasts (Upward Revision) and Revision to Final Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Zenhoren announced on 29 July 2026 an upward revision to earnings forecasts and an increase to the final dividend for fiscal year ending 31 March 2027. The final dividend per share is raised from ¥48 (previously forecast on 14 May 2026) to ¥54, a ¥6 increase. The cumulative dividend for FY3/27 is thus ¥54/share (comprised entirely of the final dividend, as no interim was paid). This compares to ¥40/share in FY3/26. The company cites strong performance driven by synergies from its April 2025 acquisition as a consolidated subsidiary of Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), cost reduction through digital efficiency, and credit-quality improvements via AI-driven underwriting. Full-year net profit forecast raised to ¥2,800M (FY3/27) from ¥2,524M, marking record profit. The dividend increase reflects the company's progressive dividend policy, which commits to maintaining or raising the per-share dividend and targets a minimum of ¥40/share or a 50% payout ratio (whichever is higher) during its medium-term plan (FY3/26–FY3/30).
